description:
[Guides] Latest Rust guides from the RustProfit blog. Every published post on blog.rustprofit.com, newest first: `title`, `slug`, `url`, `summary`, `author`,
`published` (UTC). Guides cover monuments, recyclers, farming and genetics, base building, raiding, PvP gear,
NPCs, wipes, Facepunch update explainers and skin trading. To find posts by words use `/guides/search`; for one
post's text use `/guides/posts/{slug}`. Refreshed the moment a post is published. Newest RustProfit blog guides first, optionally one topic. For a question use search_guides.

topic.description: Only posts in one topic (slug from `/guides/topics`, e.g. `base-building`).

name: list_blog_posts
title: Latest Rust guides from the RustProfit blog
